'''Protect Coruscant Green Park''' was an [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] [[Painting/Legends|poster]] that was put up on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], as part of a campaign to protect the [[Coruscant Green Park/Legends|titular park]], which had become endangered.<ref name="The Wrong Jedi" /> There was a torn version of the poster on a [[Holobooth/Legends|holobooth]] outside a [[Coruscant Underworld hotel/Legends|hotel]] on [[Level 1312/Legends|Level 1312]],<ref name="Catch">{{TCW|To Catch a Jedi}}</ref> while a full but faded version of the poster was located in [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]' neighborhood on the same level.<ref name="The Wrong Jedi" />

==Behind the scenes==
The poster seen in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[To Catch a Jedi]]" says:<ref name="Catch" />

<poem><big><big><big>PROTE</big></big></big><small>''[ripped off]''</small>
<big>CORU</big><small>''[ripped off]''</small>
<small>''[ripped off]''</small>RE<small>''[ripped off]''</small></poem>

The poster seen in the episode "[[The Wrong Jedi]]" says:<ref name="The Wrong Jedi" />

<poem>''<small>[faded]</small>''<big><big><big>OTECT</big></big></big>
''<small>[faded]</small>''<big>RUSCANT</big>
''<small>[faded]</small>''REEN PARK</poem>

This article assumes that the third word is supposed to be "[[Color|green]]."
